# MetalUI

> Soft Hardware components for React (on Base UI) and SwiftUI, with animated duotone icons. Every component ships React, SwiftUI and an agent guide.

- [Full agent guide](https://metalui.dev/AI.md)
- [Component manifest](https://metalui.dev/components.json)
- [Icon manifest](https://metalui.dev/icons.json)

## Components

- [Button](https://metalui.dev/r/button.md): A press-in pill button. It sinks 1px into a well while held and springs back on release. It comes with standard, primary and destructive caps.
- [Selection frame](https://metalui.dev/r/selection-frame.md): KAMUI-14, the one selection for every kind of object: a 1.25 green ring with a flat collar at offset 6, eight handles on the ring line, and a graphite readout of the measured frame. Hover shows only faint corner dots and an edge light.
